The note also describes PISA’s assessment structure: two two-hour tests with different item combinations across students, plus student and school questionnaires. For Italy, the factsheet states that all data met PISA quality standards, and it flags that an asterisk would indicate sampling standards not reached (not applicable to Italy here). No machine-learning models are estimated in this document; it is therefore descriptive reporting rather than an ML predictive study.
